source: Abstract
translation: 摘要

source: We study the problem of training diffusion models to sample from a distribution with a given unnormalized density or energy function. We benchmark several diffusion-structured inference methods, including simulation-based variational approaches and off-policy methods (continuous generative flow networks). Our results shed light on the relative advantages of existing algorithms while bringing into question some claims from past work. We also propose a novel exploration strategy for off-policy methods, based on local search in the target space with the use of a replay buffer, and show that it improves the quality of samples on a variety of target distributions. Our code for the sampling methods and benchmarks studied is made public at (link) as a base for future work on diffusion models for amortized inference.
translation: 我们研究了训练扩散模型以从给定未归一化密度或能量函数的分布中采样的问题。我们对几种基于扩散结构的推断方法进行了基准测试，包括基于仿真的变分方法和离策略方法（连续生成流网络）。我们的结果揭示了现有算法之间的相对优势，同时也质疑了一些过去工作的主张。我们还提出了一种针对离策略方法的新探索策略，该策略基于目标空间中的局部搜索，并使用回放缓冲区，结果显示它在各种目标分布上提高了样本质量。我们公开了用于采样方法和基准测试的代码（链接），作为未来关于扩散模型用于摊销推断的工作的基础。

source: Approximating and sampling from complex multivariate distributions is a fundamental problem in probabilistic deep learning [e.g., 27, 35, 26, 48, 57] and in scientific applications ⟦0⟧. The problem of drawing samples from a distribution given only an unnormalized probability density or energy is particularly challenging in high-dimensional spaces and when the distribution of interest has many separated modes ⟦1⟧. Sampling methods based on Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) – such as Metropolis-adjusted Langevin [MALA; 24, 65, 64] and Hamiltonian MC [HMC; 20, 31] – may be slow to mix between modes and have a high cost per sample. While variants such as sequential MC [SMC; 25, 13, 16] and nested sampling ⟦2⟧ have better mode coverage, their cost may grow prohibitively with the dimensionality of the problem. This motivates the use of amortized variational inference, i.e., fitting parametric models that sample the target distribution.

source: Despite the advances in sampling methods and attempts to unify them theoretically ⟦0⟧, the field suffers from some failures in benchmarking and reproducibility, with the works differing in the choice of model architectures, using unstated hyperparameters, and even disagreeing in their definitions of the same target densities (see §B.1). The first main contribution of this paper is a unified library for diffusion-structured samplers. The library has a focus on off-policy methods (continuous GFlowNets) but also includes simulation-based variational objectives such as PIS. Using this codebase, we are able to benchmark methods from past work under comparable conditions and confirm claims about exploration strategies and desirable inductive biases, while calling into question other claims on robustness and sample efficiency. Our library also includes several new modeling and training techniques, and we provide preliminary evidence of their utility in possible future work (§5.3).

source: We conduct comprehensive benchmarks of various diffusion-structured samplers, encompassing both GFlowNet samplers and methods such as PIS. source: As noted in §5.1, in the main experiments we fixed the diffusion rate of the learned forward process, an assumption inherited from all past work and justified in the continuous-time limit. However, we perform an experiment to show the importance of extensions such as learning the forward variance in discrete time. Fig. 3 shows the samples of models on the 25GMM energy following the experimental setup of ⟦0⟧. We see that when the forward policy’s variance is learned, the model can better capture the details of the target distributions, choosing a low variance in the vicinity of the peaks to avoid ‘blurring’ them through the noise added in the last step of sampling.
translation: 正如§5.1所指出的，在主要实验中，我们将学习到的正向过程的扩散率固定下来，这一假设源自所有过去的工作，并在连续时间极限下得到了证明。然而，我们进行了一项实验，以展示诸如在离散时间学习正向方差等扩展的重要性。图3展示了在25GMM能量上遵循实验设置⟦0⟧的模型样本。我们看到，当正向策略的方差被学习时，模型可以更好地捕捉目标分布的细节，在峰值附近选择低方差以避免通过采样的最后一步添加的噪声而‘模糊’它们。

source: 6 Conclusion
translation: 6 结论

source: We have presented a study of diffusion-structured samplers for amortized inference over continuous variables. Our results suggest promising techniques for improving the mode coverage and efficiency of these models. Future work on applications can consider inference of high-dimensional parameters of dynamical systems and inverse problems. In probabilistic machine learning, extensions of this work should study integration of our amortized sequential samplers as variational posteriors in an expectation-maximization loop for training latent variable models, as was recently done for discrete compositional latents by ⟦1⟧, and for sampling Bayesian posteriors over high-dimensional model parameters. The most important direction of theoretical work is understanding the continuous-time limit (⟦0⟧→∞) of all the algorithms we have studied.
translation: 我们提出了对用于连续变量摊销推断的扩散结构采样器的研究。我们的结果表明，这些模型在提高模式覆盖率和效率方面具有前景的技术。未来关于应用的工作可以考虑动态系统高维参数的推理和逆问题。在概率机器学习中，这项工作的扩展应研究将我们的摊销顺序采样器作为变分后验，在训练潜变量模型的期望最大化循环中集成，最近对于离散组合潜变量由⟦1⟧完成，以及对高维模型参数的贝叶斯后验抽样。理论工作的最重要方向是理解我们研究的所有算法的连续时间极限（⟦0⟧→∞）。

source: NeurIPS Paper Checklist
translation: NeurIPS 论文检查清单

source: 1. Claims
translation: 1. 声称

source: Question: Do the main claims made in the abstract and introduction accurately reflect the paper’s contributions and scope? Answer: [Yes] Justification: See theory and experiment sections. Guidelines:
translation: 问题：摘要和引言中提出的主声称是否准确反映了论文的贡献和范围？答案：[是] 解释：请参阅理论和实验部分。指南：

source: • The answer NA means that the abstract and introduction do not include the claims made in the paper.
translation: • 答案NA意味着摘要和引言中不包含论文中提出的声称。

source: • The abstract and/or introduction should clearly state the claims made, including the contributions made in the paper and important assumptions and limitations. A No or NA answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers.
translation: • 摘要和/或引言应明确陈述所提出的声称，包括论文中的贡献以及重要的假设和局限性。对这个问题的回答为否或NA将不会被审稿人看好。

source: • The claims made should match theoretical and experimental results, and reflect how much the results can be expected to generalize to other settings.
translation: • 提出的声称应与理论和实验结果相匹配，并反映结果在其他设置下可以预期的泛化程度。

source: • It is fine to include aspirational goals as motivation as long as it is clear that these goals are not attained by the paper.
translation: • 只要明确这些目标并未在论文中实现，包含作为动机的远大目标是可以的。

source: 2. Limitations
translation: 2. 局限性

source: Question: Does the paper discuss the limitations of the work performed by the authors? Answer: [Yes] Justification: Yes, see section 5.3 and conclusion, as well as references to appendix material where relevant. Guidelines:
translation: 问题：论文是否讨论了作者所做工作的局限性？答案：[是] 解释：是的，请参见第5.3节和结论部分，以及相关附录材料的引用。指南：

source: • The answer NA means that the paper has no limitation while the answer No means that the paper has limitations, but those are not discussed in the paper.
translation: • 答案“NA”意味着论文没有局限性，而答案“否”则表示论文存在局限性，但这些局限性在论文中未被讨论。

source: • The authors are encouraged to create a separate "Limitations" section in their paper.
translation: • 鼓励作者在其论文中创建一个单独的“局限性”部分。

source: • The paper should point out any strong assumptions and how robust the results are to violations of these assumptions (e.g., independence assumptions, noiseless settings, model well-specification, asymptotic approximations only holding locally). The authors should reflect on how these assumptions might be violated in practice and what the implications would be.
translation: • 论文应指出任何强假设及其结果对违反这些假设的鲁棒性（例如，独立性假设、无噪声设置、模型良好规范、仅局部有效的渐近逼近）。作者应反思这些假设在实践中可能如何被违反以及其启示。

source: • The authors should reflect on the scope of the claims made, e.g., if the approach was only tested on a few datasets or with a few runs. In general, empirical results often depend on implicit assumptions, which should be articulated.
translation: • 作者应反思所提出的主张的范围，例如，如果方法仅在一个有限的数据集上进行了测试或进行了几次运行。一般来说，实证结果往往依赖于隐含假设，这些假设应该被明确表述。

source: • The authors should reflect on the factors that influence the performance of the approach. For example, a facial recognition algorithm may perform poorly when image resolution is low or images are taken in low lighting. Or a speech-to-text system might not be used reliably to provide closed captions for online lectures because it fails to handle technical jargon.
translation: • 作者应反思影响方法性能的因素。例如，面部识别算法在图像分辨率低或在低光照条件下拍摄的图像时表现不佳。或者语音转文字系统可能无法可靠地为在线讲座提供字幕，因为它无法处理技术术语。

source: • The authors should discuss the computational efficiency of the proposed algorithms and how they scale with dataset size.
translation: • 作者应讨论所提出的算法的计算效率及其随数据集大小扩展的情况。

source: • If applicable, the authors should discuss possible limitations of their approach to address problems of privacy and fairness.
translation: • 如适用，作者应讨论其方法在解决隐私和公平性问题方面的可能局限性。

source: • While the authors might fear that complete honesty about limitations might be used by reviewers as grounds for rejection, a worse outcome might be that reviewers discover limitations that aren’t acknowledged in the paper. The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community. Reviewers will be specifically instructed to not penalize honesty concerning limitations.
translation: • 尽管作者可能会担心完全坦诚地讨论局限性会被审稿人作为拒绝的理由，但更糟糕的结果可能是审稿人发现论文中未承认的局限性。作者应运用自己的判断力，并认识到支持透明度的个人行动在维护社区诚信方面发挥着重要作用。审稿人将特别指示不要因局限性的坦诚而处罚。

source: 3. Theory Assumptions and Proofs
translation: 3. 理论假设与证明

source: Question: For each theoretical result, does the paper provide the full set of assumptions and a complete (and correct) proof? Answer: [NA]
translation: 问题：对于每个理论结果，论文是否提供了完整的假设集和完整的（正确的）证明？答案：[NA]

source: Justification: No new theoretical results. For exposition of the mathematical basis for our algorithms, we state the assumptions. Guidelines:
translation: 理由：没有新的理论结果。为了阐述算法的数学基础，我们陈述了假设。指南：

source: • The answer NA means that the paper does not include theoretical results. • All the theorems, formulas, and proofs in the paper should be numbered and crossreferenced.
translation: • 答案NA意味着论文不包含理论结果。• 论文中的所有定理、公式和证明都应编号并交叉引用。

source: • All assumptions should be clearly stated or referenced in the statement of any theorems.
translation: • 所有假设应在任何定理的陈述中明确说明或引用。

source: • The proofs can either appear in the main paper or the supplemental material, but if they appear in the supplemental material, the authors are encouraged to provide a short proof sketch to provide intuition.
translation: • 证明可以出现在主论文或补充材料中，但如果它们出现在补充材料中，鼓励作者提供简短的证明概要以提供直觉。

source: • Inversely, any informal proof provided in the core of the paper should be complemented by formal proofs provided in appendix or supplemental material.
translation: • 反之，在论文主体中提供的任何非正式证明都应通过附录或补充材料中的正式证明来补充。

source: • Theorems and Lemmas that the proof relies upon should be properly referenced.
translation: • 证明所依赖的定理和引理应适当引用。

source: 4. Experimental Result Reproducibility
translation: 4. 实验结果可重复性

source: Question: Does the paper fully disclose all the information needed to reproduce the main experimental results of the paper to the extent that it affects the main claims and/or conclusions of the paper (regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not)? Answer: [Yes] Justification: See experiment sections and references to appendix material. Guidelines:
translation:
问题：论文是否充分披露了所有必要的信息，以便能够重复论文的主要实验结果，从而影响论文的主要主张和/或结论（无论是否提供了代码和数据）？
答案：[是]
理由：请参阅实验部分及对附录材料的引用。
指南：

source: • The answer NA means that the paper does not include experiments. • If the paper includes experiments, a No answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers: Making the paper reproducible is important, regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not. • If the contribution is a dataset and/or model, the authors should describe the steps taken to make their results reproducible or verifiable. • Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways. For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model. In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed. • While NeurIPS does not require releasing code, the conference does require all submissions to provide some reasonable avenue for reproducibility, which may depend on the nature of the contribution. For example (a) If the contribution is primarily a new algorithm, the paper should make it clear how to reproduce that algorithm. (b) If the contribution is primarily a new model architecture, the paper should describe the architecture clearly and fully. (c) If the contribution is a new model (e.g., a large language model), then there should either be a way to access this model for reproducing the results or a way to reproduce the model (e.g., with an open-source dataset or instructions for how to construct the dataset). (d) We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility. In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results. 5. Open access to data and code
translation: • 答案NA表示论文不包含实验。 • 如果论文包含实验，对这个问题回答否将不会被审稿人看好：无论是否提供代码和数据，使论文可复现都是重要的。 • 如果贡献是一个数据集和/或模型，作者应描述他们采取的步骤以使其结果可复现或可验证。 • 根据不同的贡献，可复现性可以通过多种方式实现。例如，如果贡献是一种新颖的架构，全面描述该架构可能就足够了；如果贡献是一个特定模型及其经验评估，则可能需要让其他人能够使用相同的数据库复制该模型，或者提供访问该模型的方法。一般来说，发布代码和数据通常是实现这一目标的好方法之一，但也可通过详细说明如何复制结果、提供托管模型的访问（例如，在大语言模型的情况下）、发布模型检查点或其他适合所进行研究的方法来提供可复现性。 • 尽管NeurIPS不要求发布代码，但会议要求所有提交的论文提供某种合理的可复现途径，这取决于贡献的性质。例如 (a) 如果贡献主要是新算法，论文应明确说明如何复现该算法。 (b) 如果贡献主要是新模型架构，论文应清晰全面地描述该架构。 (c) 如果贡献是一个新模型（例如，一个大语言模型），则应有访问该模型以复现结果的方法，或者有复现该模型的方法（例如，使用开源数据集或构建数据集的说明）。 (d) 我们认识到在某些情况下可复现性可能会比较棘手，在这种情况下，作者可以描述他们提供的具体可复现方式。对于闭源模型，可能模型的访问受到限制（例如，仅限注册用户），但其他研究人员应该有可能通过某种途径复现或验证结果。 5. 数据和代码的开放访问

source: Question: Does the paper provide open access to the data and code, with sufficient instructions to faithfully reproduce the main experimental results, as described in supplemental material?
translation: 问题：论文是否提供了开放访问的数据和代码，并附有充分的说明以忠实再现主要实验结果，如补充材料所述？

source: Answer: [Yes] Justification: We provide code to reproduce nearly all of our experimental results.
translation: 答案：[是] 理由：我们提供了几乎可以重现所有实验结果的代码。

source: Guidelines:
translation: 指南：

source: • The answer NA means that paper does not include experiments requiring code. • Please see the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines (⟦0⟧ public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy) for more details. • While we encourage the release of code and data, we understand that this might not be possible, so “No” is an acceptable answer. Papers cannot be rejected simply for not including code, unless this is central to the contribution (e.g., for a new open-source benchmark). • The instructions should contain the exact command and environment needed to run to reproduce the results. See the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines (https: //nips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy) for more details. • The authors should provide instructions on data access and preparation, including how to access the raw data, preprocessed data, intermediate data, and generated data, etc. • The authors should provide scripts to reproduce all experimental results for the new proposed method and baselines. If only a subset of experiments are reproducible, they should state which ones are omitted from the script and why. • At submission time, to preserve anonymity, the authors should release anonymized versions (if applicable). • Providing as much information as possible in supplemental material (appended to the paper) is recommended, but including URLs to data and code is permitted.
translation: • 答案NA表示论文不包含需要代码的实验。• 请参阅NeurIPS代码和数据提交指南（⟦0⟧ public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy）以获取更多详细信息。• 尽管我们鼓励发布代码和数据，但我们理解这可能无法实现，因此“否”是一个可接受的答案。除非贡献的核心部分（例如，新的开源基准）需要代码，否则不能仅因未包含代码而拒绝论文。• 说明应包含运行以重现结果的确切命令和环境。请参阅NeurIPS代码和数据提交指南（https://nips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy）以获取更多详细信息。• 作者应提供有关数据访问和准备的说明，包括如何访问原始数据、预处理数据、中间数据和生成的数据等。• 作者应提供脚本以重现新提出的算法和基线的所有实验结果。如果只有部分实验可复现，他们应说明哪些实验被省略以及原因。• 提交时，为了保持匿名性，作者应发布匿名版本（如适用）。• 建议在补充材料（附加到论文中）中尽可能多地提供信息，但允许包含指向数据和代码的URL。

source: 6. Experimental Setting/Details
translation: 6. 实验设置/细节

source: Question: Does the paper specify all the training and test details (e.g., data splits, hyperparameters, how they were chosen, type of optimizer, etc.) necessary to understand the results?
translation: 问题：论文是否指定了所有训练和测试细节（例如，数据划分、超参数、它们是如何选择的、优化器类型等）以理解结果？

source: Answer: [Yes] Justification: See the experiment sections and references to appendix material.
translation: 答案：[是] 理由：请参见实验部分和对附录材料的引用。

source: • The answer NA means that the paper does not include experiments.
translation: • �答案NA表示论文不包含实验。

source: • The experimental setting should be presented in the core of the paper to a level of detail that is necessary to appreciate the results and make sense of them.
translation: • 实验设置应在论文的核心部分详细呈现，以便读者理解结果并对其有充分的认识。

source: • The full details can be provided either with the code, in appendix, or as supplemental material.
translation: • 完整的细节可以通过代码、附录或补充材料提供。

source: 7. Experiment Statistical Significance
translation: 7. 实验统计显著性

source: Question: Does the paper report error bars suitably and correctly defined or other appropriate information about the statistical significance of the experiments?
translation: 问题：论文是否适当地报告了误差棒或其他关于实验统计显著性的适当信息，并且定义正确？

source: Answer: [Yes] Justification: All results tables and plots show standard deviation and indicate significance of the best metric.
translation: 答案：[是] 理由：所有结果表格和图表均显示标准差，并指出了最佳度量的显著性。

source: • The answer NA means that the paper does not include experiments. • The authors should answer "Yes" if the results are accompanied by error bars, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests, at least for the experiments that support the main claims of the paper.
translation: • 答案NA意味着论文不包含实验。• 如果结果伴随有误差棒、置信区间或统计显著性检验，至少对于支持论文主要论点的实验，作者应回答“是”。

source: • The factors of variability that the error bars are capturing should be clearly stated (for example, train/test split, initialization, random drawing of some parameter, or overall run with given experimental conditions).
translation: • 误差棒所捕获的变化因素应明确说明（例如，训练/测试分割、初始化、某些参数的随机抽取，或在给定实验条件下进行的整体运行）。

source: • The method for calculating the error bars should be explained (closed form formula, call to a library function, bootstrap, etc.)
translation: • 计算误差棒的方法应予以解释（封闭形式公式、调用库函数、自助法等）。

source: • The assumptions made should be given (e.g., Normally distributed errors).
translation: • 应明确给出所作假设（例如，误差呈正态分布）。

source: • It should be clear whether the error bar is the standard deviation or the standard error of the mean. • It is OK to report 1-sigma error bars, but one should state it. The authors should preferably report a 2-sigma error bar than state that they have a 96% CI, if the hypothesis of Normality of errors is not verified. • For asymmetric distributions, the authors should be careful not to show in tables or figures symmetric error bars that would yield results that are out of range (e.g. negative error rates). • If error bars are reported in tables or plots, The authors should explain in the text how they were calculated and reference the corresponding figures or tables in the text.
translation: • 应清楚说明误差棒是标准差还是均值的标准误。• 报告一倍标准差误差棒是可以的，但应明确说明。如果未验证误差正态性的假设，作者最好报告两倍标准差误差棒，而不是声明具有96%置信区间。• 对于非对称分布，作者在表格或图形中展示对称误差棒时应谨慎，以免得出超出范围的结果（例如负误差率）。• 如果在表格或图中报告了误差棒，作者应在文本中解释其计算方法，并在文本中引用相应的图或表。

source: 8. Experiments Compute Resources
translation: 8. 实验计算资源

source: Question: For each experiment, does the paper provide sufficient information on the computer resources (type of compute workers, memory, time of execution) needed to reproduce the experiments?
translation: 问题：对于每个实验，论文是否提供了足够的信息来复现所需的计算资源（计算节点类型、内存、执行时间）？

source: Answer: [Yes] Justification: See experiment sections and references to appendix material.
translation: 回答：[是] 正当理由：参见实验部分及附录材料引用。

source: • The paper should indicate the type of compute workers CPU or GPU, internal cluster, or cloud provider, including relevant memory and storage.
translation: • 论文应指明计算节点类型（CPU或GPU、内部集群或云服务提供商），包括相关内存和存储。

source: • The paper should provide the amount of compute required for each of the individual experimental runs as well as estimate the total compute.
translation: • 论文应提供每个单独实验运行所需的计算量，并估算总计算量。

source: • The paper should disclose whether the full research project required more compute than the experiments reported in the paper (e.g., preliminary or failed experiments that didn’t make it into the paper).
translation: • 论文应披露整个研究项目是否需要比论文中报告的实验更多的计算资源（例如，未进入论文的初步或失败实验）。

source: 9. Code Of Ethics
translation: 9. 职业道德准则

source: Question: Does the research conducted in the paper conform, in every respect, with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics ⟦0⟧?
translation: 问题：本文中的研究是否在各个方面都符合NeurIPS职业道德准则？⟦0⟧

source: Answer: [Yes] Justification: We believe there are no violations of the CoE.
translation: 答案：[是] 理由：我们认为没有违反职业道德准则的行为。

source: • The answer NA means that the authors have not reviewed the NeurIPS Code of Ethics.
translation: • 答案为“不适用”意味着作者未审查NeurIPS职业道德准则。

source: • If the authors answer No, they should explain the special circumstances that require a deviation from the Code of Ethics. • The authors should make sure to preserve anonymity (e.g., if there is a special consideration due to laws or regulations in their jurisdiction).
translation: • 如果作者回答“否”，他们应解释需要偏离职业道德准则的特殊情况。• 作者应确保匿名性（例如，如果由于其所在地区的法律或规定有特殊考虑）。

source: 10. Broader Impacts
translation: 10. 更广泛影响

source: Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed?
translation: 问题：本文是否讨论了所进行工作的潜在积极社会影响和消极社会影响？

source: Answer: [NA] Justification: The paper studies a ML problem with no immediate societal impacts.
translation: 答案：[不适用] 理由：本文研究了一个没有直接社会影响的机器学习问题。

source: • The answer NA means that there is no societal impact of the work performed.
translation: • 答案NA意味着该工作对社会没有影响。

source: • If the authors answer NA or No, they should explain why their work has no societal impact or why the paper does not address societal impact.
translation: • 如果作者回答NA或No，他们应解释其工作为何对社会没有影响，或者论文为何未涉及社会影响。

source: • Examples of negative societal impacts include potential malicious or unintended uses (e.g., disinformation, generating fake profiles, surveillance), fairness considerations (e.g., deployment of technologies that could make decisions that unfairly impact specific groups), privacy considerations, and security considerations.
translation: • 社会影响的负面例子包括潜在的恶意或意外用途（例如，传播虚假信息、生成虚假个人资料、监控），公平性考虑（例如，部署可能不公平地影响特定群体的技术），隐私考虑以及安全考虑。

source: • The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments. However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out. For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate deepfakes for disinformation. On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster.
translation: • 大会预期许多论文将是基础研究，并不与特定应用相关，更不用说部署了。然而，如果存在直接通往任何负面应用的路径，作者应该指出这一点。例如，指出改进生成模型的质量可能会被用于制作深度伪造视频来传播虚假信息是合理的。另一方面，不需要指出一个通用的优化神经网络的算法能够使人们更快地训练生成深度伪造视频的模型。

source: • The authors should consider possible harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended and functioning correctly, harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended but gives incorrect results, and harms following from (intentional or unintentional) misuse of the technology.
translation: • 作者应考虑技术按预期使用且正常运行时可能出现的危害，技术按预期使用但产生错误结果时可能出现的危害，以及由于技术的故意或无意误用而产生的危害。

source: • If there are negative societal impacts, the authors could also discuss possible mitigation strategies (e.g., gated release of models, providing defenses in addition to attacks, mechanisms for monitoring misuse, mechanisms to monitor how a system learns from feedback over time, improving the efficiency and accessibility of ML).
translation: • 如果存在负面的社会影响，作者还可以讨论可能的缓解策略（例如，限制模型的发布，提供防御措施而非仅攻击手段，监控误用的机制，监控系统如何随着时间从反馈中学习的机制，提高机器学习的效率和可访问性）。

source: 11. Safeguards
translation: 11. 防护措施

source: Question: Does the paper describe safeguards that have been put in place for responsible release of data or models that have a high risk for misuse (e.g., pretrained language models, image generators, or scraped datasets)?
translation: 问题：论文是否描述了为负责任地发布具有高误用风险的数据或模型（例如，预训练的语言模型、图像生成器或抓取的数据集）而采取的防护措施？

source: Answer: [NA] Justification: The paper studies a ML problem with no immediate application to generation of new image or text content, nor other functions that have the potential for misuse, to the best of our knowledge.
translation: 答案：[NA] 原因：据我们所知，本文研究的机器学习问题没有直接应用于生成新图像或文本内容，或其他可能被滥用的功能。

source: • The answer NA means that the paper poses no such risks. • Released models that have a high risk for misuse or dual-use should be released with necessary safeguards to allow for controlled use of the model, for example by requiring that users adhere to usage guidelines or restrictions to access the model or implementing safety filters. • Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks. The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images. • We recognize that providing effective safeguards is challenging, and many papers do not require this, but we encourage authors to take this into account and make a best faith effort.
translation: • 答案NA表示该论文不涉及此类风险。 • 对于存在高误用或双重用途风险的已发布模型，应采取必要的安全措施来允许对模型进行受控使用，例如要求用户遵守使用指南或限制访问模型，或者实施安全过滤器。 • 从互联网抓取的数据集可能带来安全风险。作者应说明他们如何避免发布不安全的图像。 • 我们认识到提供有效防护措施具有挑战性，并且许多论文并不需要这样做，但我们鼓励作者考虑这一点并尽最大努力处理。

source: 12. Licenses for existing assets Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected?
translation:
12. 现有资产的许可证
问题：论文中使用的资产（例如代码、数据、模型）的创作者或原始所有者是否得到了适当的署名？许可证及使用条款是否明确提及并得到适当尊重？

source: Answer: [Yes] Justification: We cite the works introducing all datasets we study.
translation: 回答：[是]理由：我们引用了所有研究数据集的原始作品。

source: • The answer NA means that the paper does not use existing assets. • The authors should cite the original paper that produced the code package or dataset. • The authors should state which version of the asset is used and, if possible, include a URL. • The name of the license (e.g., CC-BY 4.0) should be included for each asset. • For scraped data from a particular source (e.g., website), the copyright and terms of service of that source should be provided. • If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided. For popular datasets, paperswithcode.com/datasets has curated licenses for some datasets. Their licensing guide can help determine the license of a dataset.
translation: • 答案NA表示该论文未使用现有资源。 • 作者应引用生成代码包或数据集的原始论文。 • 作者应说明所使用的资源版本，并尽可能包含URL。 • 每个资源的许可证名称（例如，CC-BY 4.0）应被包括。 • 对于从特定来源（例如网站）抓取的数据，应提供该来源的版权和使用条款。 • 如果资源已发布，应在包中提供许可证、版权信息和使用条款。对于流行的数据集，paperswithcode.com/datasets 已整理了一些数据集的许可证。他们的许可指南可以帮助确定数据集的许可证。

source: • For existing datasets that are re-packaged, both the original license and the license of the derived asset (if it has changed) should be provided.
translation: • 对于重新打包的现有数据集，应提供原始许可证以及衍生资产的许可证（如果已更改）。

source: • If this information is not available online, the authors are encouraged to reach out to the asset’s creators.
translation: • 若此信息无法在线获取，作者被鼓励联系资产的创建者。

source: 13. New Assets
translation: 13. 新资产

source: Question: Are new assets introduced in the paper well documented and is the documentation provided alongside the assets? Answer: [NA] Justification: No new assets. Guidelines:
translation: 问题：论文中新引入的资产是否得到了充分的文档记录，并且这些文档是否与资产一同提供？答案：[NA]理由：没有新资产。指南：

source: • The answer NA means that the paper does not release new assets.
translation: • 答案 NA 表示论文未发布新资产。

source: • Researchers should communicate the details of the dataset/code/model as part of their submissions via structured templates. This includes details about training, license, limitations, etc.
translation: • 研究人员应通过结构化模板在提交时沟通数据集/代码/模型的详细信息。这包括关于训练、许可证、局限性等的细节。

source: • The paper should discuss whether and how consent was obtained from people whose asset is used.
translation: • 论文应讨论是否以及如何从使用其资产的人那里获得同意。

source: • At submission time, remember to anonymize your assets (if applicable). You can either create an anonymized URL or include an anonymized zip file.
translation: • 提交时，请记得匿名您的资产（如果适用）。您可以创建一个匿名的URL或包含一个匿名的zip文件。

translation: 14. 众包和人类受试者研究

translation: 问题：对于众包实验和涉及人类受试者的研究，论文是否包含了提供给参与者的完整指令文本和截图（如有），以及有关补偿（如有）的详细信息？答案：[NA]理由：没有人类研究。指南：

source: • The answer NA means that the paper does not involve crowdsourcing nor research with human subjects. • Including this information in the supplemental material is fine, but if the main contribution of the paper involves human subjects, then as much detail as possible should be included in the main paper.
translation: • 答案 NA 表示论文不涉及众包或人类受试者的研究。• 将此信息包含在补充材料中是可以的，但如果论文的主要贡献涉及人类受试者，则应在主文中尽可能多地包含详细信息。

source: • According to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics, workers involved in data collection, curation, or other labor should be paid at least the minimum wage in the country of the data collector.
translation: • 根据 NeurIPS 伦理准则，参与数据收集、整理或其他劳动的人员应至少获得数据收集者所在国家的最低工资。
